text: このへんなら　オレが　くわしいぜ！

structure.en: when it comes to this area

structure.jp: オレが　くわしいぜ！
structure.en: I'm the one who knows it well!

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a thing means 'if that's what we're talking about'. このへんなら = 'when it comes to this area'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, confident guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. くわしいぜ = 'I know it well, you bet'.
